newsitem.title: USA: Alternative Living Services Q4 loss widens.
newsitem.headline: Alternative Living Services Q4 loss widens.

text.p: Alternative Living Services Inc said Thursday higher development, construction and acquisition costs contributed to a steeper loss in the fourth quarter ended December 31.
The company reported a loss of $1.6 million, or $0.12 a share, compared to a loss of $696,000, or $0.09 a share, a year ago. Company officials said the results were in line with expectations.

Alternative Living Services said it operated 77 centers at the end of 1996 versus 18 at the end of 1995 thanks to new construction and acquisitions. Those moves sent revenues to $14.6 million from $3.1 million a year ago, the company said.
Alternative Living Services operates 79 assisted living residences in 11 states.
Its shares were off 1/8 Thursday afternoon at 14-3/4.
